A stack and a queue are both data structures used to store elements, but they operate differently. 

1. A Stack is like a pile of plates where you can only add or remove the top plate. This means that if you want to access an element at the bottom of the stack, you have to first move all other plates up.

2. A Queue, on the other hand, is like a line of people waiting for their turn. You can add new people to the end of the line and remove people from the front

- Добавление элементов происходит с вершины.
